title: Vectors: IPv6 test vectors
description: Create test/vectors/ipv6-*.json. Cover: address derivation (fe80 + 200::/7), ICMPv6 messages. All three implementations must pass.
close_reason: IPv6 address and ICMPv6 shared vectors exist and both Python and Rust consume them. test/vectors/ipv6-addresses.json covers key-derived fe80::/10 plus native 0200::/8 (spec; not ULA) with stdlib generator generate_ipv6_addresses.py. test/vectors/ipv6-icmpv6.json covers Echo Request/Reply and dest-unreach/PTB/time-exceeded; independent stdlib generator generate_ipv6_icmpv6.py --check matches committed wires. yggdrasil-derivation.json and yggdrasil_address.json already had Python+Rust consumers. Added rust/lichen-core/tests/ipv6_address_vectors.rs for key-derived fe80+0200 binding. Python tests: 76 passed. Rust lichen-core ipv6_address_vectors+icmpv6_echo_vectors+yggdrasil_addr_vectors+short_addr_vectors: 14 passed. C/Zephyr consumer not required this turn.
